title: A Study to Assess Beta-Lactam in the Treatment of Hospitalized Patients With Bacterial Pneumonia
brief_summary: This study will assess the efficacy and safety of intravenous beta-lactam, in comparison with ceftriaxone, in hospitalized patients with community-acquired pneumonia not caused by Legionella. The anticipated time on study treatment is 3-12 months and the target sample size is 100-500 individuals.
